newsitem.title: USA: Prudential sees value in U.S. natgas producers.
newsitem.headline: Prudential sees value in U.S. natgas producers.

text.p: After downgrading three U.S. natural gas producers to sell from hold earlier Monday morning, Prudential analyst Frank Braken said this did not reflect an overall downgrade of the sector.

"Our basic strategy is to sell high premium and multiple stocks whose earnings are susceptible to a softer gas market and to focus on really cheap names. But the sector as a whole remains very healthy," said Bracken.
Bracken cut Cabot Oil & Gas Corp, Lomak Petroleum and Newfield Exploration to sell from hold.
Cabot was trading down 3/4 at $18, Newfield down 2 1/4 at 20 3/4 and Lomak off 1 5/8 at 18 5/8 by 1130 EST.

"We see surging gas suplies in the U.S. which outpaced demand growth and this results in a softer market in fiscal 1998 and some companies are going to report flat or down earnings," said Prudential analyst Frank Bracken.
Bracken said he remained a buyer of American Exploration Co, Cairn Energy USA Inc and Ranger Oil. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
